note.p: This page contains instructions for opening templates when Template Versioning is enabled. For instructions on opening templates without versioning, see Opening Templates in this guide.

conbody.p: Using X-Author Templates, you can open any template version from the repository and make changes to static text and other content in the document. When the document is finalized, you can check in the template and modify properties as needed (for example, you can change which contract types it is associated with). As with contracts, when you check out a template, a lock is enabled on the document, preventing other users from editing it while you are working on it. After you release the lock or check in the template, the lock is released.
